name: Lady Malys
abilities: Core: Leader; Feel No Pain 5+. Archon of the Poisoned Tongue (Pain): when her unit shoots or fights, one token empowers it and grants either Sustained Hits 1 or Lethal Hits for that phase.
Precognisant: redeploy up to three Drukhari units after both armies deploy; they may enter Strategic Reserves beyond the normal quantity limit.
Mind Like a Steel Trap: once per turn, increase by 1CP a stratagem used on an opposing unit within 12″ of Malys.
impact: Her attachment carries the main Incubi hammer. Keep CP available for a taxed defensive stratagem. Do not lock your deployment around her initial position; she can change three drops.

name: Incubi
loadout: 10 models/180pts with Malys (2 tokens); 5/90pts with Drazhar (1 token). Each Klaivex has demiklaives.
abilities: Decapitating Strikes (Pain): empower when selected to fight; melee gains Devastating Wounds against Infantry for that phase.
Tormentors: nearby engaged enemies test Battle-shock at the start of the Fight phase; Incubi gain +1 to hit Battle-shocked targets.
Each Shrine token is once per battle: turn one Incubi/Klaivex hit or wound roll into an unmodified 6. It cannot change an attached character’s roll.
impact: Dangerous into Scarabs: two-damage klaives and token-generated critical wounds can bypass saves. Their Infantry-only Pain benefit does not grant those devastating wounds against Magnus.

name: Drazhar
abilities: Core: Leader. Master of Blades (Pain): empower when selected to fight; the unit gains +1 to wound in melee.
Onslaught: while leading, the unit’s pile-in and consolidation maximum becomes 6″.
Silent Executioner: Drazhar rerolls hits against depleted units and also wounds against units below half-strength.
impact: A dead screen can give his unit access to a second unit through 6″ post-charge moves, subject to movement conditions. His +1 to wound and Lance do not produce an unrestricted +2: wound-roll modifiers are capped.

name: Archon
loadout: 100pts including Nightmare Shroud; leads Kabalites; huskblade and Soul Trap, no pistol.
abilities: Core: Leader. Hatred Eternal (Pain): empower when selected to shoot/fight for unit-wide hit rerolls that phase.
Overlord: once per battle, at a phase’s start, clear Battle-shock from a friendly Drukhari unit within 12″.
Devious Mastermind: once per battle round, one bearer in the army discounts a stratagem targeting its unit by 1CP.
Shadowfield: no save rerolls for the unit while he has his invulnerable save; losing a non-mortal wound removes his invulnerable save for the battle.
Soul Trap adds 1 attack and Strength to his melee weapon; after his first melee model-kill it adds another 1 to each for the battle.
impact: With Kabalites, one Shooting-phase empowerment activates both the leader’s hit rerolls and their wound rerolls. Nightmare Shroud protects his own disembarked unit from Overwatch, not every passenger elsewhere.
weapons: Devastating Wounds; second values after first melee kill

name: Kabalite Warriors
loadout: 10/110pts; Archon attached; 5 rifles, dark lance, blaster, shredder, cannon; Sybarite blast pistol, power weapon and grenade launcher.
abilities: Sadistic Raiders (Pain): empower on shoot/fight selection; reroll wound rolls of 1, or all wound rolls against a target on an objective.
Cruel Enforcers: an objective held at the end of their Command phase remains controlled until the opponent exceeds their control at a phase end.
Phantasm Grenade Launcher gives Smoke and Grenades. No Kabalite Icon is listed. A Venom can split the squad during battle formations.
impact: Remove these scoring pieces when possible: sticky control lets the army leave objectives. Archon plus special weapons becomes a strong disembarking shooting package.

name: Lelith Hesperax
abilities: Core: Leader, Fights First. Blur of Blades gives Fights First to her led unit.
Brides of Death (Pain): empower when selected to fight; improve melee Strength and AP by 1 for her unit.
Thrilling Spectacle: once per battle at the Fight phase’s start, her attacks become 12 and her invulnerable save becomes 3+ for that phase.
impact: Shoot this unit before committing Scarabs into melee. Precision and Anti-Infantry 2+ make exposed Sorcerers vulnerable. Her own S3 and anti-Infantry do not translate into automatic wounds on Magnus.

name: Wyches
loadout: Two units of 10/90pts each. Lelith squad: 3 gladiatorial weapons, 6 blades/pistols, Hekatrix power weapon/blast pistol. Succubus squad: 10 blades/pistols.
abilities: Acrobatic Gladiators (Pain): empower at the start of their Charge phase to charge after an advance or fall-back that turn.
No Escape: enemy units leaving engagement by falling back must test every model for Desperate Escape, except Monsters/Vehicles; Battle-shocked escapees suffer −1 to those tests.
impact: M8 plus advance-and-charge makes a fast threat. Trapping Rubrics/Scarabs is dangerous; Magnus is excluded from this particular fall-back penalty. Charge and Fight phase empowerment are separate expenditures.

name: Succubus
loadout: 70pts including Periapt of Torments; leads basic Wyches.
abilities: Core: Leader. Lithe Agility (Pain): empower when selected to advance or before a charge roll; reroll advance/charge rolls while empowered that phase.
Storm of Blades: while leading, her unit’s melee weapons gain Sustained Hits 1.
Bloody Spectacle: her attacks reroll hits/wounds against Character units; her unit destroying a Character model generates 1CP.
impact: Periapt prevents snap-shooting attacks against the attachment. Spend through Wyches at the start of Charge to enable an advance-and-charge and activate the Succubus charge reroll. A Movement-phase advance reroll needs a separate empowerment.

name: Raider
loadout: Two at 75pts; one dark lance each; capacity 11 Drukhari Infantry, excluding Jump Pack.
abilities: Core: Deep Strike, Firing Deck 11, Deadly Demise D3. Splinter Racks (Pain): empower to shoot; if occupied, reroll hits for its ranged Anti weapons.

Vanguard of the Dark City: select ONE mode in Command, lasting until next Command: sticky control with embarked Kabalites; wholly-within-6″ Wych disembarks (not emergency); extra boarding attacks per embarked Wrack; or advance/charge rerolls while carrying Drukhari.
impact: A full ten-model squad plus leader fits. The Wych disembark mode and occupied-boat reroll mode are alternatives. No Wracks are listed, so that option has no payload here.

name: Venom
loadout: Three at 65pts; two splinter cannons each; capacity 6 Drukhari Infantry excluding Jump Pack.
abilities: Core: Deep Strike, Stealth, Firing Deck 6, Deadly Demise 1. Rapid Deployment (Pain): empower when advancing to let passengers use shock disembark after that advance.
Aerialists: at the Fight phase’s end, an empty Venom can pick up an unengaged, non-Flying Drukhari Infantry unit of at most six models wholly within 6″, including a unit that disembarked that turn.
Before battle formations, each Venom may split one previously unsplit Kabalite/Hand/Wych squad equally; one half must start inside it.
impact: Confirm every five-model split, which half gets the character and where the special weapons went. A full ten plus leader cannot ride in one Venom. The pickup means exposed infantry may disappear after the fight.

name: Cronos
loadout: One/55pts; no spirit vortex in the supplied list.
abilities: Core: Feel No Pain 5+, Deadly Demise 1. Pain Parasite (Pain): empower for shooting/fighting; killing models can heal up to three wounds after attacks. Its multi-model resurrection clause cannot restore a destroyed single-model starting unit.

Pain Engine: empowerment tokens spent for friendly units within 9″ can be refunded on 5+, with +1 to the roll when a Cronos lacks a vortex. This listed model therefore refunds on a natural 4+. Other token expenditures do not qualify.
impact: The support engine sustains repeated empowerments. Remove it when doing so does not cost your answer to an immediate assault.

name: Mandrakes
abilities: Core: Deep Strike, Infiltrators, Stealth. Fade Away (Pain): spend a token at the end of your opponent’s Fight phase to remove the unengaged unit into Strategic Reserves.
Shade Weavers: ranged attackers must be within 18″ to target them.
impact: They screen, score and redeploy. Do not assume Magnus can clear them with a 24″ shot from outside their 18″ targeting restriction. Occupy landing pockets around the mission terrain.

name: Ravager
abilities: Core: Deep Strike, Deadly Demise D3. Agonising Suppression (Pain): empower to shoot; after shooting select a hit enemy unit to suffer −1 to hit until Seb’s next turn.
Eradicate the Foe: reroll hits against a target still at starting strength. At 1–4 remaining wounds, this Ravager suffers −1 to hit.
impact: Three S12 shots and natural hit rerolls threaten Magnus. Removing this gun platform is often more useful than scattering damage across several boats.

name: Reavers
loadout: Two units of 3/75pts; one heat lance and one cluster caltrops each.
abilities: Matchless Swiftness (Pain): empower when advancing for a fixed +8″ instead of rolling, giving a 24″ advance move.
Eviscerating Fly-by: after a normal/advance move over a non-Monster/Vehicle enemy, roll per bike; each 4+ inflicts one mortal wound. The listed caltrops reroll one of those dice.
impact: These are fast objective thieves and Wych Cult stratagem users. Advance-and-action can help them steal space; no automatic advance-and-charge follows from being Wych Cult. Fly-by cannot target Magnus.

name: Scourges with Heavy Weapons
loadout: Two units of 5: 130pts with four dark lances; 110pts with four heat lances. Each Solarite has blast pistol, power weapon and close combat weapon.
abilities: Core: Deep Strike. Winged Strike (Pain): empower on shooting selection for hit rerolls that phase.
Airborne Evasion: after shooting, if unengaged, make a normal move up to 6″; doing so prevents charging that turn.
impact: Plan around shoot-then-hide rather than expecting a return shot. Four heat lances become D6+3 within 9″. Heavy rewards remaining stationary; Assault belongs to the heat lances, not the dark lances.
